         <lb n="198a3"/> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4653"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3711">shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa['i] rgyan</rs> ces bya ba'i 'grel bshad | 'thad ldan gsal byed rin po che'i snang ba</rs> zhes bya ba <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3924">shag kya'i dge slong rigs par smra zhing brtul shugs [zhugs] la legs par gnas pa shes rab grags</rs> kyis nye bar sbyar ba || sdzogs s+h+yo || </seg></TEI>
